Former RBI Governor Raghuram Rajan Joins US Federal Reserve Policy Review

Former Reserve Bank of India Governor Raghuram Rajan has been appointed to a US Federal Reserve task force. He will contribute to a broad overhaul of the central bank's monetary policymaking framework. Rajan's role involves examining the Fed's balance sheet policy and its impact on managing inflation and the economy.
